layout._comment_drawer: An open drawer re-lays the world: the surface rises (not above skyMin) so that at least sectionMin rows of section stay above the drawer; the section is cropped there (top layers at full scale + a history ribbon), rulerW world px at the right are the era ruler.

press._comment: Press (brief 5, A2): hold a layer >holdMs to squeeze it: compaction x6, transformations x4 in a circle of `radius` world px (+ Wide Press). Costs costShare of the income per second.

burial._comment: Burial window (brief 5, В2): >= killed violent deaths within windowYears game years opens it for `seconds` real seconds; a flood or a volcano cast in it makes bones from before..after years around now fossilise fossilMul times as easily.

sand._comment: The falling-sand strata (core/sand.ts, pressure.ts, beds.ts, world/Grid.ts, Archive.ts). One particle = 2x2 world pixels. Rows count from the top of the grid. bedRows: bedrock rows at the bottom (under the bottom menu); the thing lies on the bedrock, artifactW x artifactH particles; sinkRow = the row right above the thing: the oldest rock there sinks into the archive as a whole row when the mean column above it is taller than sinkLine x refRows (raw count, the press does not change the level); the rate is sinkRate x overload^4 rows per second, full when sinkRockShare of the row is rock, a quarter when none is. pressurePerParticle: MPa of each particle above per unit of density (calibrated in merge stage 2). gradientPerRow: degrees per particle row of depth. oxygenRows: organic matter rots this close to the surface. waterFallEvery: in water a particle falls every Nth step; waterSlipMul scales its slide chance. cellsPerParticle: how many old 1x1 cells one particle stands for in the archive (2x2). archiveMaxRows: an archive layer closes after this many rows (mean); archiveMaxLayers: above this the oldest layers of one epoch merge into a belt. pile: the pile a tap drops (base + perLevel particles). coatDepth: how deep a marker bed reaches down a steep face. coatWait: seconds a bed waits for falling particles to land. seaAboveLine: the water line stands this many rows above the line where the strata settle. bedCooldown: seconds between two ochre beds of the «Bed» button. archiveDigShare: the share of the archive's (compacted) thickness the tribe digs through in epoch VII. rockYieldMul: rock paid for a transformation of a visible particle (× yield × rockYield × cellsPerParticle); below 1 because the visible strata turn to rock sooner than the old cells did. startBelowLine: a new world (and a migrated old save) starts with the strata filled up to this many rows below the line, on the ground of the old world; seaFloorBelow: the sea floor lies this many rows lower than the land. stepsPerSecond: physics steps a second on screen (falling and sliding speed).
